Commitment to Circular Economy and Sustainability # In alignment with the global movement toward a circular economy, GPI leverages its core technologies and extensive design expertise to enhance the value of both GPI and Cartridge Web products. Our mission is to deliver high-quality products while prioritizing efficient resource recycling and minimizing the environmental impact associated with our offerings. We adhere to the 3R principles—Reduce, Reuse, Recycle—guiding our approach to product design, development, and marketing, with a strong emphasis on energy conservation and carbon footprint reduction.
ESG Commitment Green Cartridge Program: Advancing Eco-Friendly Solutions # The shift toward environmentally responsible solutions is a growing trend, particularly in Europe. Responding to this, Cartridge Web began its transition toward the green economy in June 2020. Key initiatives include reducing non-eco-friendly packaging materials and integrating recycled plastics into product components, all aimed at supporting sustainable growth and ecological responsibility while lowering resource consumption.
Our ongoing efforts focus on launching eco-friendly products, with a particular emphasis on alternative packaging materials—such as replacing plastics with pulp. In 2022, we introduced 15 eco-friendly cartridges, each utilizing up to 95% recycled plastics and eliminating plastic from packaging. These actions are aligned with our goal to minimize the use of non-environmentally friendly materials.
For more details, visit our eco-friendly section .
We remain dedicated to expanding our range of green products, ensuring customers enjoy a reliable printing experience without concerns about hazardous substances or supply shortages.
Green Cartridge Program Quality Control and Regulatory Compliance # Cartridge Web is committed to delivering products that are both safe and reliable. We routinely submit materials for SGS testing to ensure compliance with the European Union’s Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) directive, REACH requirements, and specific customer mandates regarding banned and restricted substances. Our stringent controls ensure that all components meet 100% of health and safety standards, supported by compliance declarations, testing and verification reports, and safety data sheets.
We actively monitor both domestic and international policy developments, adapting our practices to remain compliant with evolving regulations. This includes tracking relevant laws, developing policy measures, and providing educational training to maintain full legal compliance.
Quality Control 2023 Environmental Highlights # 80% reduction on plastic foam packaging 55% increase on the use of pulp cushioning materials 7.95t CO2e reduction on gas emissions per year 0.11 million kWh generated per month via solar panels on factory rooves Certified recycled plastic materials used on go-green cartridges RoHS, REACH and Hazardous substances restrictions compliant

A Legacy of Progress: Key Milestones at GPI # General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. (GPI) has built a reputation for innovation and excellence in the toner cartridge industry. Below is a chronological overview of significant milestones that have shaped the company’s journey and growth.
1978 - 1989: Foundation and Early Expansion # 1978
GPI was established by Chairman Mr. Jack Wang, marking the beginning of a commitment to quality and technological advancement.
1986
The company expanded into plastic molding production, specializing in toner cartridges for copiers and printers, laying the groundwork for future product development.
1990 - 1999: Scaling Operations and Quality Initiatives # 1995
A second plant was set up, increasing the production capacity to seven lines, reflecting growing demand and operational scaling.
1996
Implementation of ISO 9002 standards began, emphasizing a focus on quality improvement.
1997
GPI achieved ISO 9002 certification, reinforcing its dedication to quality management.
1998
Continued efforts to enhance quality through ISO 9002 practices.
1999
The company developed and successfully introduced OPC drum bases to the market, establishing manufacturing and development capabilities for complex OPC bases. Gear production was upgraded to JIS4 standards. In October, GPI developed precision gears with a 60mm outside diameter for copiers and commenced mass production.
2000 - 2009: Corporate Transformation and Brand Emergence # 2000
In April, the company name was changed to General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. In May, GPI issued stocks, and by August, total capital increased to 9.7 million USD.
2001
Shares were listed on the OTC market (Code: 6128).
2002
Mass production began for the first model of “All in one” complicated laser printer toner cartridges, with several additional models developed.
2003
Shares transitioned to listing on the TWSE.
2006
Total capital increased to 22.6 million USD.
2008
The Cartridge Web brand was created for the finished goods wholesale market, focusing on toner cartridges for printers.
2009
The “Cartridge Web” brand was further developed, seeking regional distributors and wholesalers. Total capital increased to 47.5 million USD.
2010 - Present: Diversification and Global Expansion # 2010
Construction began on a hotel building in the Taichung Harbor region, signaling diversification beyond manufacturing.
2012
GPI achieved ISO 14001 certification, demonstrating a commitment to environmental management.
2013
The Taichung Harbor Hotel held its grand opening in March.
2018
GPI completed a 100% acquisition of Katun Holdings LP, the world’s largest distributor of aftermarket imaging supplies, and completed a capital increase by cash.
2021
GPI achieved ISO 13485 certification, further enhancing its standards in quality management.
These milestones reflect GPI’s dedication to innovation, quality, and global growth, positioning the company as a leader in the imaging supplies industry.

Quality assurance in production Mass production and strict QC procedures Translating Policy into Practice # Our quality policy is not just a statement—it is a philosophy that is put into action through well-defined, sequential procedures. Task Definition: Clearly outlining the objectives and requirements for each project or process. Task Assignment: Delegating responsibilities to qualified team members to ensure accountability and expertise. Documentation and Feedback: Maintaining thorough records and encouraging feedback to support continuous improvement and transparency. Diverse Options for Printer Toner Cartridges # Based in Taiwan, Cartridge Web provides a broad selection of printer toner cartridges designed to meet the needs of clients worldwide. As a trusted supplier, we offer OEM alternative solutions compatible with a variety of leading printer brands, including HP, Kyocera Mita, Brother, Utax, Olivetti, Ricoh, Xerox, and more.
Our Product Streams # Cartridge Web’s portfolio is divided into two main categories:
New Compatible Toner Cartridges: Manufactured in our ISO9001-certified facility in Taiwan, these cartridges are designed as high-quality, cost-effective alternatives to OEM products. All new compatible cartridges are IP-free, ensuring peace of mind for our clients.
Remanufactured Toner Cartridges: These cartridges are produced by recycling and reusing original cartridge housings through our strategic partners. Each remanufactured cartridge undergoes strict quality monitoring, making them an environmentally conscious choice.
Eco-friendly Toner Cartridges: For those prioritizing sustainability, our eco-friendly toner cartridges are made using recycled post-consumer plastics. This green-conscious option reflects our commitment to environmental responsibility.
Brand Compatibility # We support a wide range of printer brands and models, including:
HP & Samsung Kyocera Mita Brother Utax Olivetti Ricoh Xerox Konica Minolta OKI Epson Dell Sharp Lexmark For detailed compatibility and model information, please refer to our dedicated product pages:
New Compatible Toner Cartridges Remanufactured Toner Cartridges Eco-friendly Toner Cartridges Commitment to Quality and Sustainability # Cartridge Web is dedicated to delivering reliable, high-quality toner cartridges while maintaining a strong focus on environmental sustainability. Our new compatible cartridges are produced under rigorous standards, and our remanufactured and eco-friendly lines offer responsible alternatives for environmentally conscious users.
For more information about our technical advantages, research and development, or quality policies, please visit our website or contact us directly.
